name: MainPlace Mall
summary: Spacious shopping center featuring department stores, a gym, a movie theater & a bowling alley.
description: Anchored by Macy's and JCPenney, this indoor shopping destination features nearly 200 stores with top brands in fashion, beauty, dining, and entertainment. Enjoy 24 Hour Fitness Super Sport, Ashley Furniture HomeStore, Round 1 Bowling & Amusement, and Funparx. Conveniently located in the heart of Orange County at the 5, 22, and 57 freeways, MainPlace is your spot to shop, dine, and play.
demographics: Westfield MainPlace serves a diverse, middle-class Orange County market with strong representation from Hispanic and Asian-American families. The trade area draws primarily from Santa Ana and surrounding communities, attracting budget-conscious shoppers and families seeking value-oriented fashion, entertainment, and dining options. Typical visitors include young families, teenagers, and multi-generational households who appreciate the mix of affordable retailers, entertainment venues like Round 1 Bowling and movie theaters, and convenient freeway access at the junction of the 5, 22, and 57 freeways.
